# Request in-person card payment method

Request the in-person card payment method so your <Term id="merchants">merchants</Term> can accept card payments with their terminal app.

## Prerequisites {#prerequisites}

import MerchantPrereqs from '../partials/_merchant-prereqs.mdx';

<MerchantPrereqs />

## Request the payment method {#request}

Call the `requestMerchantPaymentMethods` mutation.

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql
mutation RequestInPersonCardMethod {
  requestMerchantPaymentMethods(
    input: {
      merchantProfileId: "$YOUR_MERCHANT_PROFILE_ID"
      inPersonCard: {
        activate: true
      }
    }
  ) {
    ... on RequestMerchantPaymentMethodsSuccessPayload {
      merchantProfile {
        merchantPaymentMethods {
          ... on InPersonCardMerchantPaymentMethod {
            id
            methodId
            mainLocationId
            statusInfo {
              status
            }
            updatedAt
            version
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ... on ForbiddenRejection {
      __typename
      message
    }
    ... on InvalidPaymentMethodRequestRejection {
      __typename
      message
    }
  }
}
```

## Payment method review {#review}

The payment method is created with the status `PendingReview` and version number `1`.
Swan reviews all new <Term id="merchant-payment-method">merchant payment methods</Term> and might contact you for more information before accepting or rejecting the request.
The status then moves to `Enabled` or `Rejected`, or to `WaitingForInformation` if Swan needs more details ([provide missing information](../../missing-information.mdx)).
The full lifecycle is on [payment method statuses](/payments/concepts/merchants/statuses#method-statuses).
